title: Star-Crossed Lovers
welcome_lead: A sonnet opens the play and tells us how it ends.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on the prologue and structure of R&J.
final_note: You can now identify the prologue's form and the play's 5-act shape.

concepts.def: Short opening before the play's action.

walkthroughs.body_html: The play opens with a sonnet spoken by the Chorus. It calls Romeo and Juliet 'star-crossed lovers' — doomed by fate.
Like most of Shakespeare's plays, R&J has 5 acts: setup, complication, climax, fall, catastrophe.
The image of stars ruling lovers' fortunes drives the theme of fate. Their tragedy feels both chosen and pre-written.
